descriptions.description: Cunninghamia konishii is a species of tree in the cypress family, Cupressaceae. It is native to southeast China, Taiwan, Laos and Vietnam. Although C. konishii is treated as a distinct species by many sources, it has also been suggested that it is conspecific with C. lanceolata.
